## `scripts/fp/player/body_bake.gd`

extends `SceneTree`

Bakes the walking collision of every building and zone model into body_table.gd (slice A). body_shapes.gd costs 10-300 ms per model, so its results ship baked: godot --headless --path . -s res://scripts/fp/player/body_bake.gd Re-run it after a building or zone GLB changes; CollisionWorld analyses a model whose bounds no longer match its entry at runtime (once per file, with a warning). With BODY_BAKE_REPORT=1 it prints every model's shapes instead of writing the table.

### Constants

- `BS = preload("res://scripts/fp/player/body_shapes.gd")`
- `AP = preload("res://scripts/fp/asset_paths.gd")`
- `OUT_PATH = "res://scripts/fp/player/body_table.gd"`
- `BAKE_DIRS = ["res://models/real/buildings/", "res://models/real/zones/", "res://models/buildings/",...`

## `scripts/fp/player/body_shapes.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

Walking collision of a building or zone model from its own geometry (slice A deliverable 2). A building GLB merges a whole lot (grass, paths, the house, a parked car, lamps, benches, trees) into a few surfaces, so its AABB would block the yard. analyse() rasterises every triangle that can stop a walker (not ground, not under the step height, not overhead, not foliage) into a 25 cm footprint grid, fills enclosed interiors (a wall shell is a solid building), splits the grid into connected parts and returns, in model space: bodies: at most MAX_BODIES boxes, the building masses; walls:  thin boxes (fences, low walls, benches, a parked car), at most MAX_WALLS; cyls:   posts (lamps, bollards) and tree trunks, as (x, z, r, top) quadruples. `ColBox_<n>` empties (AP.COLBOX_PREFIX) replace the bodies. body_bake.gd stores the results in body_table.gd; CollisionWorld analyses an unbaked model at runtime, once per file.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `AP = preload("res://scripts/fp/asset_paths.gd")`
- `M = WS.M`
- `MAX_BODIES = 4`
- `MAX_WALLS = 24`
- `CELL = 0.25 * M`
- `LOW_TOP = WS.LOT_TOP + WS.STEP_HEIGHT`: Model-space heights: a triangle entirely under LOW_TOP is ground or steppable; one entirely over HEAD_Y is overhead (eaves, roofs, awnings) and never stops a walker.
- `HEAD_Y = WS.LOT_TOP + WS.PLAYER_HEIGHT`
- `TALL_Y = WS.LOT_TOP + 2.2 * M`: An enclosed hole is filled when at least half its rim is this tall (building walls, not fences).
- `TRUNK_FOOT = WS.LOT_TOP + 0.5 * M`: Bark triangles starting below this belong to a trunk (the rest are branches).
- `TRUNK_R_MIN = 0.15 * M`
- `TRUNK_R_MAX = 0.35 * M`
- `POST_MAX = 0.8 * M`: Parts smaller than POST_MAX both ways are posts (cylinders).
- `POST_R_MIN = 0.1 * M`
- `POST_R_MAX = 0.35 * M`
- `PIECE_WASTE = 0.12`: Rectangles of one part merge back while the merged box is at most this empty.
- `MAX_RECTS = 48`: A part is cut into at most this many rectangles.
- `BODY_MIN = 1.5 * M`: A box at least BODY_MIN wide both ways and BODY_AREA in area is a body; smaller ones are walls.
- `BODY_AREA = 6.0 * M * M`

### Inner classes

- `Grid`: A footprint grid over a model's xz bounds: per cell the lowest bottom and highest top of the triangles that cover it.

### Functions

- `static func analyse(model: Node3D) -> Dictionary`: {"bounds": AABB, "bodies": Array[AABB], "walls": Array[AABB], "cyls": PackedFloat32Array}, everything relative to the model root. bounds is the merged mesh AABB (the model's identity for body_table.gd).
- `static func merge_tight(boxes: Array[AABB], waste: float) -> Array[AABB]`: Merges pairs whose merged box is at most `waste` empty (added xz area over merged area), least added area first.
- `static func merge_to(boxes: Array[AABB], n: int) -> Array[AABB]`: Greedy merge of the pair that adds the least xz area until at most n boxes remain.

## `scripts/fp/player/hero_rig.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

HC's animated hero for the player (slice A stage A2; A-player.md 6.9, TPS_PLAN 2.9). A roster body (AP.HERO_M / AP.HERO_F) with the gender's shared library as the default library "" and an AnimationTree driven from code: MANUAL process, advanced by player_avatar.update_motion with the player's own dt, so tests and the game step it the same way. The tree is a StateMachine (locomotion, crouch, jump / fall / land, talk, sit) under a OneShot for upper-body gestures. Locomotion blends idle with a cyclic BlendSpace1D of walk, walk_fast, run and run_fast at their measured speeds (SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE gives the blended loops one shared cycle, so their left-heel phases stay locked), then a TimeScale that matches the stride to the ground speed. Foot contacts are the locomotion phase crossing 0 (left heel) and one half (right heel). LookAtModifier3Ds on Neck and Head turn the head toward a look target.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `AP = preload("res://scripts/fp/asset_paths.gd")`
- `SM = preload("res://scripts/fp/player/spring_math.gd")`
- `LOCO = ["walk", "walk_fast", "run", "run_fast"]`: Locomotion loops in blend order; HC starts each on the left-heel strike.
- `GESTURES = ["interact", "wave", "phone", "door_try"]`: Upper-body one-shots (6.9 OneShot).
- `CLIPS = ["idle", "walk", "walk_fast", "run", "run_fast", "crouch_idle", "crouch_walk", "jump_st...`: Every clip the tree plays.
- `TS_MIN = 0.5`: Foot-slide correction: TimeScale = clamp(v / v_anim, TS_MIN, TS_MAX).
- `TS_MAX = 1.5`
- `XF_JUMP = 0.08`: Cross-fades (s): into the jump, jump to fall, into the landing, landing out, crouch, talk, sit, and walking off a ledge into the fall.
- `XF_FALL = 0.1`
- `XF_LAND = 0.06`
- `XF_LAND_OUT = 0.15`
- `XF_CROUCH = 0.2`
- `XF_TALK = 0.3`
- `XF_SIT = 0.3`
- `XF_LEDGE = 0.2`
- `JUMP_SKIP = 0.05`: jump_start opens on a crouch before take-off, but FpPlayer leaves the ground on the press: the clip starts at take-off.
- `JUMP_VY = 0.5`: Rising faster than this fraction of JUMP_SPEED when the feet leave the ground is a jump.
- `AIR_DELAY = 0.12`: Ungrounded this long without a jump (off a ledge) before the fall pose (s).
- `LAND_MIN = 0.2`: The landing dip: land is blended over idle by the impact speed, LAND_MIN of it for a soft landing, all of it from LAND_FULL m/s down (a 0.6 m hop lands at 3.4 m/s: about half).
- `LAND_FULL = 10.0`
- `LAND_INTERRUPT = 0.5`: Moving input may leave the landing after this fraction of the clip; otherwise it plays out.
- `LAND_MOVING = 0.6`: Faster than this (m/s) the body leaves (or skips) the landing for locomotion at once: the landing clip stands still, so its feet would slide under a moving body.
- `STILL = 0.05`: Below this (m/s) the body stands; talk and gestures need it below TALK_STILL.
- `TALK_STILL = 0.3`
- `CONTACT_SAMPLES = 64`: Feet analysis: samples per locomotion cycle and over idle, and how close (m) to its lowest point near the nominal strike a heel counts as down.
- `IDLE_SAMPLES = 24`
- `CONTACT_EPS = 0.005`
- `CONTACT_BEFORE = 0.2`: The window, in cycles around the nominal heel strike, that the contact search covers; blends are measured at 1 / BLEND_STEPS steps of weight.
- `CONTACT_AFTER = 0.15`
- `BLEND_STEPS = 8`
- `GROUND_STATES = ["crouch", "land"]`: UAL's crouch and landing clips, retargeted onto Rocketbox legs, hold the feet a few centimetres above the ground: in those states the body is lowered until both feet rest on it (each foot's lowest point; the other may sink at most GROUND_SINK), by at most GROUND_DOWN (GROUND_UP upward), with this halflife (s).
- `GROUND_DOWN = 0.08`
- `GROUND_UP = 0.03`
- `GROUND_SINK = 0.01`
- `HL_GROUND = 0.08`
- `STEP_MIN_MOVE = 0.25`: Footsteps sound while the walk blend is at least this strong.
- `SHOT_IN = 0.25`: Gesture one-shot fades (s).
- `SHOT_OUT = 0.35`
- `SIT_SPEED = 1.5`: sit_down and stand_up play this much faster than authored (in and out of a car seat).
- `SIT_CLIPS = ["sit_down", "stand_up"]`
- `LOOK_YAW = deg_to_rad(70.0)`: Head look (6.9): Head limits (yaw, pitch), the Neck's share and limit, the modifier's own interpolation, the influence fade when the target leaves the limits, and the halflife that smooths a jumping target.
- `LOOK_PITCH = deg_to_rad(35.0)`
- `NECK_INFLUENCE = 0.35`
- `NECK_LIMIT = deg_to_rad(45.0)`
- `LOOK_DURATION = 0.35`
- `LOOK_FADE = 0.3`
- `HL_LOOK = 0.12`
- `LOOK_REARM = deg_to_rad(8.0)`: A faded-out look comes back once the target is this far inside the limits (no flicker at the edge).
- `LOOK_SAFE_MARGIN = 0.5`: Skeleton-local (metres): closer targets interpolate (LookAtModifier3D.origin_safe_margin).
- `UPPER_ROOT = "Spine"`: A gesture moves the bones from here up; the legs keep their state.
- `P_SM = "parameters/sm/playback"`
- `P_MOVE = "parameters/sm/loco/move/blend_amount"`
- `P_BS = "parameters/sm/loco/bs/blend_position"`
- `P_TS = "parameters/sm/loco/ts/scale"`
- `P_PHASE = "parameters/sm/loco/bs/walk/"`
- `P_CBS = "parameters/sm/crouch/bs/blend_position"`
- `P_CTS = "parameters/sm/crouch/ts/scale"`

- `P_GESTURE = "parameters/gesture/transition_request"`
- `P_SHOT = "parameters/shot/request"`
- `P_SHOT_ACTIVE = "parameters/shot/active"`

### Properties

- `body: Node3D`: The body's scene root (faces +Z, feet at y = 0, metric) and its parts.
- `gender: String`: "m" or "f".
- `speeds: Dictionary`: Clip -> ground speed in m/s on this body at its CharacterRoot scale (speed_mps * hip ratio * h_target / rest height), and clip -> length (s).
- `time_scale: float`: The last foot-slide factor v / v_anim (clamped; 1 while standing) and the locomotion phase (cycles, 0..1: the left heel strikes at 0, the right at 0.5; -1 outside locomotion).
- `move: float`: The idle-to-walk weight of the last update.
- `contacts: Array[Dictionary]`: Foot contacts of the last update: [{"left": bool, "pos": Vector3 (world, the foot's ground point)}].
- `ground_fix: float`: How far the body is lowered to put the soles on the ground (skeleton metres; _update_ground).
- `look_weight: float`: Head-look influence (0..1) and whether the modifier last found its target within its limits.
- `head_forward: Vector3`: The head's forward (world) as the look-at modifiers left it, from the last frame they ran.

### Functions

- `static func build(path: String, lib_path: String, k: float, p_gender: String) -> RefCounted`: Instantiates the body at path with the AnimationLibrary at lib_path; k is the body's speed factor (hip_m / speed_ref_hip_m * h_target / rest height). Null when a file is missing or the body has no %GeneralSkeleton.
- `func update(dt: float, v: float, grounded: bool, vy: float, crouched: bool, talking: bool) -> void`: Per frame: v is the signed forward ground speed (m/s; negative walks backward), vy the vertical speed (m/s), crouched and talking the player's states. Advances the tree by dt and fills contacts with the heel strikes it crossed.
- `func state() -> String`: The state machine's current state ("loco", "crouch", "jump", "fall", "land", "talk", "sit_down", "sit", "stand_up").
- `func sit(on: bool) -> void`: Sits down (on) or stands up; moving stands up by itself.
- `func play_gesture(g: String) -> void`: Plays an upper-body gesture over the current state ("interact", "wave", "phone", "door_try").
- `func gesture_active() -> bool`
- `func stop_gesture() -> void`: Fades the playing gesture out before its end.
- `func travel(clip: String, t: float) -> float`: How far clip has carried its root t seconds after its state began (0..1 of the whole clip's horizontal root travel; sit_down and stand_up play at SIT_SPEED). The tree drops root motion, so whoever moves the body through a clip (into a car seat) follows this curve; a clip without travel runs linearly.
- `func root_travel(clip: String) -> float`: How far clip carries the body along the ground over its whole length (world units).
- `func set_look_target(p: Vector3) -> void`: The world point the head turns toward; NAN components let the head return to the clip.
- `func snap(crouched: bool) -> void`: Back to standing (or crouched) locomotion at once: no cross-fade, no landing, no gesture.
- `func bone_world(bone: String) -> Vector3`: A bone's world position (the animated pose, before the look-at modifiers).
- `func feet_low(ground_y: float) -> float`: How far the lowest part of either sole is above the given world height (world units): per foot the lower of the heel (the ankle bone above its standing height) and the toe (the toe bone above its standing height), for tests.
- `func stride(a: float) -> float`: The ground one gait cycle (two steps) covers at speed a (m/s), in metres.
- `func contact_phases(st: String = "loco") -> Vect`: The (left, right) heel contact phases of the current blend: "loco" those of the blended pose between the two clips around the blend position, "crouch" crouch_walk's.

## `scripts/fp/player/placeholder_puppet.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The legacy person (models/real/people/person_*.glb) re-rigged as a jointed puppet, so the placeholder hero walks, runs, crouches and jumps until HC's animated hero replaces it (stage A2). The legacy people are built from separate primitives per segment (thigh, knee ball, shin, shoe; shoulder ball, upper arm, elbow ball, forearm, hand), posed mid-stride. build() finds those pieces, derives the joints (ball centres and segment end caps), straightens every segment about its joint and parents it into a hip -> knee -> ankle and shoulder -> elbow chain, with the neck, head and hair on a head joint; the avatar drives the joints with a procedural gait and a head look. Model space: +Z forward, +X the figure's left. A model whose pieces do not match falls back to the rigid body (build() returns null).

### Constants

- `SIDES = 2`: 0 = left (+X), 1 = right (-X)
- `CAP_FRAC = 0.8`: Far end of a segment: the vertices beyond this fraction of the farthest distance from a joint.

### Properties

- `head: Node3D`: The head joint (neck base), a child of spine; null when the model has no separate neck piece.
- `pelvis_rest: Vector3`: Rest layout (model units): the pelvis origin, the ankle height above the soles and the sagittal segment lengths.

### Functions

- `static func build(path: String, ps: PackedScene) -> RefCounted`: The puppet for a legacy person scene, or null when the model is not built from the expected pieces (the caller keeps the rigid body).
- `func apply(hip: Array, knee: Array, ankle: Array, shoulder: Array, elbow: Array, pelvis_off: Vector3, lean: float) -> void`: Joint angles in radians for one frame. Each side: hip (forward swing), knee (flexion), ankle (relative, toes down positive), shoulder (forward swing), elbow (flexion). pelvis_off is the pelvis offset from its rest position (model units), lean the spine's forward lean.
- `func look(yaw: float, pitch: float) -> void`: Head look in the spine's frame (radians): yaw toward the figure's left, pitch up.
- `func reach(h: float, k: float) -> float`: Vertical reach of a leg (hip to ankle, model units) at hip swing h and knee flexion k.
- `func forward_reach(h: float, k: float) -> float`: Forward reach of a leg (hip to ankle along +Z, model units).

## `scripts/fp/player/player.gd`

class_name `FpPlayer` · extends `Node3D`

The on-foot player (slice A): feet at `position`, a kinematic controller against the analytic CollisionWorld (no physics bodies, D2) and the one current Camera3D. Third person (the play default, D13) hangs the camera on TpsRig's over-the-shoulder spring arm and shows the Avatar; V switches to first person at eye height (the body then only casts its shadow). Walk, run, crouch, jump with coyote time and a buffer, curb steps, sliding along walls and poles, head bob, footsteps, shoulder swap, zoom, free-fly photo mode and the conversation two-shot. `yaw` is the body yaw (rotation.y); cam_yaw / cam_pitch are the view; movement input is relative to the view.

### Signals

- `stepped(surface: String, pos: Vector3)`: A foot came down: on the gait's foot contacts (the left heel at phase 0, the right at PI; the placeholder's visible stride follows the same phase). pos is that foot's ground point, surface comes from CollisionWorld.surface_at.
- `landed(speed_mps: float)`: The hero touched down after LAND_STEP_MIN_AIR or more in the air, right after that landing's stepped; speed_mps is the downward speed at touchdown.
- `photo_mode_changed(on: bool)`: Photo mode was entered or left.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `SM = preload("res://scripts/fp/player/spring_math.gd")`
- `AVATAR = preload("res://scripts/fp/player/player_avatar.gd")`
- `GROUND_SNAP = 0.05`: Gaps above this between a loaded position and the ground snap to the ground.
- `MAX_FRAME_DELTA = 0.1`: Longest frame _process hands to simulate(), in seconds. A sim tick stall can freeze a frame for 0.7-2.7 s; the player then moves one 10 fps frame's worth instead of lurching ahead.
- `MAX_SUBSTEPS = 4096`: Upper bound on collision sub-steps per simulate() call (each moves at most PLAYER_RADIUS).
- `HL_SPEED_UP = 0.15`
- `HL_SLOW_DOWN = 0.10`
- `HL_AIR = 0.5`
- `HL_BODY_YAW = 0.10`
- `YAW_RATE_WALK = deg_to_rad(720.0)`
- `YAW_RATE_RUN = deg_to_rad(450.0)`
- `TURN_MIN_SPEED = 0.2 * WS.M`
- `PIVOT_ANGLE = deg_to_rad(135.0)`
- `PIVOT_MIN_SPEED = 2.5 * WS.M`
- `PIVOT_TIME = 0.3`
- `HL_PIVOT_VEL = 0.06`
- `HL_PIVOT_YAW = 0.08`
- `COYOTE_TIME = 0.10`
- `JUMP_BUFFER = 0.12`
- `HEAVY_LAND_SPEED = 4.0 * WS.M`
- `HEAVY_LAND_TIME = 0.3`
- `LAND_STEP_MIN_AIR = 0.15`: Shorter drops (a curb stepped off at a run) are not a foot contact of their own.
- `HL_EYE = 0.06`: Eye height follows crouch and stand with this halflife.
- `HL_FP_STEP = 0.08`: First-person eye catching up after a curb step.
- `FACE_RATE = deg_to_rad(270.0)`: Scripted facing on interact: turn in place when the error is over FACE_MIN_ERROR.

- `STEP_PER_MPS = 0.21`
- `LOOK_AHEAD = 10.0 * WS.M`: With nothing to look at, the hero looks at the point this far along the view.
- `TURN_STEPS = 4.0`: Gait phase per radian turned in place (scripted facing): 4 is two steps per quarter turn.
- `FOOT_SPREAD = 0.09 * WS.M`: Footsteps sound this far either side of the body's centre line.

- `CONV_IN = 0.6`
- `CONV_OUT = 0.45`
- `CONV_FOV = 45.0`
- `CONV_BACK = 0.9 * WS.M`
- `CONV_BACK_SHORT = 0.6 * WS.M`
- `CONV_SIDE = 0.6 * WS.M`
- `CONV_UP = 0.1 * WS.M`
- `CONV_LOOK_T = 0.6`
- `CONV_LOOK_DOWN = 0.05 * WS.M`
- `CONV_PROBE = 0.2 * WS.M`
- `CONV_FREE_MIN = 0.7`
- `REVERSE_GAP = 2.5`
- `TRAFFIC_POLL = 0.1`

- `AGENT_REACH = 8.0 * WS.M`
- `AGENT_SIZES = {"car": Vector3(2.3, 1.0, 1.6), "emergency": Vector3(2.8, 1.1, 2.4), "bus": Vector3(6.0...`: Approximate agent boxes for the camera (half length, half width, height), metres * M.

### Properties

- `yaw: float`: radians; body yaw = rotation.y. Body forward = (-sin(yaw), 0, -cos(yaw)).
- `pitch: float`: radians; the view pitch (= cam_pitch), kept for S0 callers
- `velocity: Vector3`: u/s; y is the vertical speed
- `input_enabled: bool`: false for tests and scripted tours
- `autopilot: Dictionary`: Scripted movement while input_enabled is false (photo tour shots of the hero in motion): {"wish": Vector2, "sprint": bool}; empty for none.
- `photo_mode: bool`: free-fly photo mode; FpMode ignores hud_toggle and C ignores chat_open while true
- `cam_yaw: float`: View angles (radians). Movement input is rotated by cam_yaw; forward() looks along them.
- `camera_mode: String`: "third" (over the shoulder) or "first" (eye height).
- `view_override: bool`: True while another owner (the city overview) places the camera through set_view_override().

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`: Builds the camera (sharing ctx.env, so SkyDirector's sky applies), the avatar and the rig, applies the settings (camera mode included) and makes the camera current.
- `func teleport(pos: Vector3, yaw_deg: float, pitch_deg: float = 0.0, snap: bool = true) -> void`: Places the feet at pos (y snapped to the ground when snap is true), sets the body and the view to yaw / pitch (degrees) and snaps the camera (springs, pivot, arm, blends): no swoop.
- `func ride(pos: Vector3, body_yaw: float, view_yaw: float) -> void`: Carries the body with a vehicle (input off): feet at pos, body yaw and view yaw in radians, no ground snap and no camera snap (the vehicle owns the view through set_view_override).
- `func look_toward(target: Vector3) -> void`: Faces a world point: the view (yaw and pitch) and the body.
- `func eye_position() -> Vector3`: World position of the head (feet + current eye height; crouching lowers it). Talk and interact ranges are measured from here in both cameras.
- `func view_position() -> Vector3`: Where the camera is (the arm end in third person).
- `func view_dir() -> Vector3`: Unit direction the camera looks along.
- `func forward() -> Vector3`: Unit look direction (cam_yaw, cam_pitch).
- `func body_forward() -> Vector3`: Unit horizontal direction the body faces.
- `func tile() -> int`: Tile index under the feet or -1.
- `func snap_to_ground() -> void`: Puts the feet on the walkable ground under them (no change over unwalkable ground).
- `func speed() -> float`: Horizontal speed in u/s.
- `func simulate(wish: Vector2, sprint: bool, delta: float, crouch: bool = false, jump: bool = false) -> void`: One deterministic movement step; _process calls it with the held input, tests call it directly. wish: x = strafe right, y = forward, each -1..1, relative to the view (cam_yaw). While ctx.is_modal(), simulate itself zeroes wish and jump (gravity and ground snap still run). crouch and jump are held states (a jump fires on the press, buffered JUMP_BUFFER s). In photo mode it flies the camera instead (jump up, crouch down). Any delta is safe: the step is split so that no collision sub-step moves farther than PLAYER_RADIUS (a 0.008 u hoarding grown by the radius is only 0.038 u thick), and a velocity component whose move was blocked drops to zero.
- `func update_view(delta: float) -> void`: Places the camera for this frame: the first-person eye (bob, step smoothing), the rig, the conversation shot or the photo camera, through any running blend; updates the avatar (lean, fade, shadow-only). _process calls it every frame; tests driving simulate() call it with their own dt.
- `func look(d_yaw: float, d_pitch: float) -> void`: Mouse or stick look (radians): turns the view; in first person the body turns with it.
- `func mouse_look(event: InputEventMouseMotion) -> void`: Turns the view by a mouse motion at mouse_sensitivity radians per screen pixel. Reads screen_relative: `relative` is scaled by the window's content-scale stretch (canvas_items, 1600x900 base), so look speed would change with the window size. Applied raw, never smoothed.
- `func set_camera_mode(m: String, blend: bool = true) -> void`: Switches between "first" and "third" (V); blend eases over MODE_BLEND s. Does not write the settings (toggle_camera_mode does).
- `func toggle_camera_mode() -> void`: V: flips the camera mode and saves the choice in the settings (the next session boots in it).
- `func set_view_override(xf: Transform3D, fov: float, blend: float = 0.0) -> void`: Hands the camera to another owner: until clear_view_override(), update_view puts it at xf with fov while the body, rig and avatar keep updating. The first call eases in over blend seconds; later calls (one per frame) move it at once.
- `func clear_view_override(blend: float = MODE_BLEND) -> void`: Gives the camera back to the player's own view, easing over blend seconds.
- `func swap_shoulder() -> void`: Q: the camera moves to the other shoulder (saved in the settings).
- `func set_photo_mode(on: bool) -> void`: P: enters or leaves the free-fly photo mode (HUD hidden, no modal, the sim keeps running). The feet follow the camera while flying and return on exit; the body stays where it stood.
- `func to_dict() -> Dictionary`: Save section: {"pos": [x, y, z], "yaw": deg (body), "pitch": deg (view), "crouched", "photo" (always false), "cam_yaw": deg, "cam_pitch": deg, "camera_mode"}.
- `func from_dict(d: Dictionary) -> void`: Restores to_dict(); {} (or no "pos") spawns at ctx.mode.spawn_point(). Saves without the camera fields take the view from the body and the mode from the settings.
- `func face_point(p: Vector3) -> void`: Turns the body in place toward a world point (interact): only when it is more than 60 degrees off and the player is nearly still (A 6.4 scripted facing).
- `func in_conversation() -> bool`: True while the conversation two-shot (or its first-person turn) is active.
- `func conversation_id() -> String`: The resident id of the active conversation, or "".
- `func gait_phase() -> float`: The gait phase in radians (the left heel strikes at 0, the right at PI).

## `scripts/fp/player/player_avatar.gd`

extends `Node3D`

The player's visible body (slice A). Stage A2: HC's animated hero (hero_rig.gd: AP.HERO_M or AP.HERO_F per settings.hero, the gender's shared animation library, an AnimationTree driven from code, head look through LookAtModifier3Ds) under a CharacterRoot scaled to the hero's height (WS.M * h_target / rest_height_m from HC's roster), turned to face the player's -Z forward. When the hero's files are missing it falls back to the stage A1 placeholder: the legacy person (AP.PEOPLE_LEGACY_DIR person_a.glb at WS.PEOPLE_SCALE) re-rigged as a jointed puppet (placeholder_puppet.gd) that walks, runs, crouches, jumps and lands with a procedural gait. Either body's foot contacts drive FpPlayer's footsteps. Procedural lean about the feet and a damped visual step offset apply on top. The head turns toward a look target (A 6.9: the conversation partner, the focused interactable or where the camera looks). In first person the body only casts its shadow; in third person it fades out when the camera comes close to the head.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `AP = preload("res://scripts/fp/asset_paths.gd")`
- `SM = preload("res://scripts/fp/player/spring_math.gd")`
- `PUPPET = preload("res://scripts/fp/player/placeholder_puppet.gd")`
- `HERO = preload("res://scripts/fp/player/hero_rig.gd")`
- `ROSTER_DEFAULTS = {"m": {"rest_height_m": 1.7951, "hip_m": 0.8952}, "f": {"rest_height_m": 1.7164, "hip_m...`: HC's roster defaults (Rocketbox: one skeleton per gender) for a checkout without roster.json.
- `HERO_H = 1.75`: Hero heights (m; HC-characters.md 1.9): the man at WS.PERSON_H, the woman 5 % shorter.
- `HERO_F_FACTOR = 0.95`
- `PLACEHOLDERS = {"m": "person_a.glb", "f": "person_b.glb"}`: Placeholder bodies per settings.hero (the legacy people are not gendered; b reads as the alternative figure).
- `LEAN_ROLL_K = 0.35`: Procedural lean (A 6.4): roll = clamp(0.35 atan(v w / g), +-8 deg), pitch = clamp(0.5 atan(a_fwd / g), -5..+7 deg), spring halflife 0.1 s.
- `LEAN_ROLL_MAX = deg_to_rad(8.0)`
- `LEAN_PITCH_K = 0.5`
- `LEAN_PITCH_MIN = deg_to_rad(-5.0)`
- `LEAN_PITCH_MAX = deg_to_rad(7.0)`
- `HL_LEAN = 0.1`
- `HL_STEP = 0.05`: The visual step offset decays with this halflife (A 6.4: avatar y after a curb step).
- `RIGID_CROUCH_Y = 0.7`: A body that cannot be re-rigged has no crouch pose: it squats to this height and tips forward.
- `RIGID_CROUCH_TIP = deg_to_rad(12.0)`
- `HL_MOVE = 0.08`: Blend weights follow their goals with these halflives (s).
- `HL_RUN = 0.15`
- `HL_CROUCH = 0.08`
- `HL_AIR_IN = 0.06`
- `HL_AIR_OUT = 0.04`
- `HL_LAND = 0.12`
- `MOVE_FULL = 0.55`: The gait is fully on from this fraction of WALK; the run pose from RUN_FROM to RUN_FULL (m/s).
- `RUN_FROM = 1.9`
- `RUN_FULL = 3.8`
- `LAND_HARD = 3.0`: Landing harder than this (m/s down) gives the full landing dip.
- `CROUCH_HIP = 80.0`: Crouch base pose and how much of the gait remains while crouched.
- `CROUCH_KNEE = 112.0`
- `CROUCH_LEAN = 26.0`
- `CROUCH_ELBOW = 35.0`
- `CROUCH_GAIT = 0.55`
- `RUN_LOW = 0.06`: Running pelvis height below rest (m) at mid-stance and its rise into the flight phase (m); pelvis sway while walking (m).
- `RUN_LIFT = 0.045`
- `WALK_SWAY = 0.012`
- `LOOK_YAW_MAX = deg_to_rad(70.0)`
- `LOOK_PITCH_MAX = deg_to_rad(35.0)`
- `LOOK_GIVE_UP = deg_to_rad(110.0)`
- `HL_LOOK = 0.1`
- `TURN_SHUFFLE_RATE = deg_to_rad(180.0)`: Turning in place at this rate or faster takes full-size shuffle steps (rad/s); their size.
- `TURN_SHUFFLE = 0.6`
- `BREATH_DEG = 0.7`: Idle breathing: spine and shoulder swing (degrees) and rate (Hz).
- `BREATH_HZ = 0.23`

### Properties

- `hero: String`: "m" or "f" (settings.hero).
- `hero_paths: Dictionary`: Body and library per hero; a missing file falls back to the placeholder (tests point these at missing files to exercise it).
- `placeholder: bool`: True when the loaded body is the legacy placeholder.
- `rig: RefCounted`: HC's animated hero (hero_rig.gd), or null for the placeholder.
- `puppet: RefCounted`: The jointed placeholder (placeholder_puppet.gd), or null for a rigid body.
- `head_look: Vector2`: Current head look (yaw toward the figure's left, pitch up), radians.
- `joints: Dictionary`: The last pose's joint angles (radians) per side, for tests: {"hip", "knee", "ankle", "shoulder", "elbow"} -> [left, right].

### Functions

- `func set_hero(h: String) -> void`: Loads the body for hero ("m" or "f"): HC's animated hero, else the placeholder; a body that cannot load keeps the current one.
- `func is_animated() -> bool`: True while HC's animated hero is the body (its clips then own the gait and the footsteps).
- `func gait_phase() -> float`: The hero's locomotion phase in radians (the left heel strikes at 0, the right at PI), or NAN outside locomotion; NAN for the placeholder.
- `func contacts() -> Array[Dictionary]`: Foot contacts of the last update_motion (hero only): [{"left": bool, "pos": Vector3}].
- `func play_gesture(g: String) -> void`: Plays an upper-body gesture on the hero ("interact", "wave", "phone", "door_try").
- `func set_view_state(shadow_only: bool, alpha: float) -> void`: First person: shadow only (you see your shadow, never your body). alpha 0..1 fades the body in third person (0 hides it, so the near plane never cuts through the head).
- `func update_motion(dt: float, speed: float, yaw_rate: float, fwd_acc: float, step: float, crouch: float = 0.0, phase: float = 0.0, grounded: bool = true, vy: float = 0.0, talking: bool = false, backward: bool = false) -> void`: Per frame: lean from the planar velocity (u/s), yaw rate (rad/s) and forward acceleration (u/s^2); step is the feet's sudden vertical jump this frame (a curb), absorbed visually; crouch is 0 standing .. 1 crouched; phase is FpPlayer's gait phase (radians, the left heel strikes at 0 and the right at PI); grounded and vy (u/s) drive the jump and landing poses. talking holds the hero in its talk loop; backward plays its walk in reverse (first person).
- `func set_look_target(p: Vector3) -> void`: The world point the head turns toward (NAN components: look straight ahead).
- `func snap() -> void`: Clears lean and step offsets and the gait blends (teleport).
- `func lean() -> Vector2`: Current lean (roll, pitch) in radians, for tests.
- `func is_body_visible() -> bool`: True while the body draws (not shadow-only and not faded out).
- `func pose_metrics() -> Dictionary`: The pelvis offset from its rest position (metres * M) and the lowest ankle above the feet (metres * M), for tests; zero for a rigid body.

## `scripts/fp/player/spring_math.gd`

class_name `SpringMath` · extends `RefCounted`

Frame-rate independent dampers and springs for the player and the third-person camera. After D. Holden, "Spring-It-On" (theorangeduck.com/page/spring-roll-call), MIT. Every function is exact for any dt, so the same input at 30 fps and at 144 fps lands in the same place.

### Constants

- `LN2 = 0.69314718056`

### Functions

- `static func damp(x: float, goal: float, halflife: float, dt: float) -> float`: Exponential damper: moves x toward goal; half the gap closes every `halflife` seconds.
- `static func damp_factor(halflife: float, dt: float) -> float`: The fraction of the gap damp() closes in dt.
- `static func damp_v3(x: Vector3, goal: Vector3, halflife: float, dt: float) -> Vector3`: damp() for a Vector3.
- `static func damp_angle(a: float, goal: float, halflife: float, dt: float) -> float`: damp() for an angle in radians, the shortest way round; the result is wrapped to [-PI, PI].
- `static func spring(x: float, v: float, goal: float, halflife: float, dt: float) -> Vector2`: Critically damped spring: returns Vector2(x, v) after dt. Never overshoots a static goal from rest; halflife is roughly the time for the error to halve.
- `static func spring_angle(a: float, v: float, goal: float, halflife: float, dt: float) -> Vector2`: spring() for an angle in radians (shortest way round); x is wrapped to [-PI, PI].
- `static func velocity_spring(vel: Vector2, acc: Vector2, goal: Vector2, halflife: float, dt: float) -> Array`: The critically damped spring applied to a planar velocity (x = velocity, v = acceleration): returns [velocity, acceleration, displacement] after dt, the displacement being the exact integral of the velocity over the step (so the walked distance is frame-rate independent).
- `static func stop_distance(v0: float, halflife: float) -> float`: Distance a velocity spring (goal 0) still travels when released at speed v0.
- `static func smooth01(t: float) -> float`: smoothstep on [0, 1].
- `static func blend_xform(a: Transform3D, b: Transform3D, t: float) -> Transform3D`: Camera blend: position lerp and basis slerp (both orthonormalised first).
- `static func yaw_pitch_of(b: Basis) -> Vector2`: Vector2(yaw, pitch) of a camera basis looking along -Z (yaw = rotation.y, pitch = rotation.x).
- `static func look_basis(yaw: float, pitch: float) -> Basis`: The camera basis for yaw and pitch (YXZ Euler, no roll).

## `scripts/fp/player/tps_rig.gd`

class_name `TpsRig` · extends `RefCounted`

Over-the-shoulder follow camera (D13; docs/fp/slices/A-player.md 6.5-6.6): an analytic spring arm root -> shoulder -> hand -> camera, swept against CollisionWorld boxes (no physics, D2). Pure logic: FpPlayer feeds it the body state each frame and copies cam_xform, fov and player_alpha to the camera and the avatar. Lengths are metres * M.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `SM = preload("res://scripts/fp/player/spring_math.gd")`
- `M = WS.M`
- `PIVOT_BELOW_EYE = 0.10 * M`: pivot 1.55 m above the feet: the neck, 0.10 m under the eye
- `ARM_UP = 0.10 * M`: the "hand" above the shoulder pivot
- `SHOULDER_X = 0.40 * M`
- `DIST_DEFAULT = 3.2 * M`
- `DIST_MIN = 1.6 * M`
- `DIST_MAX = 5.0 * M`
- `ZOOM_STEP = 0.4 * M`
- `DIST_RUN_ADD = 0.4 * M`
- `CAM_RADIUS = 0.20 * M`: > the near-plane corner (0.124 m at 60 deg), < PLAYER_RADIUS
- `GROUND_CLEAR = 0.20 * M`
- `FADE_NEAR = 0.45 * M`: the hero is hidden when the camera is this close to the head
- `FADE_FAR = 0.90 * M`
- `LEAD_TIME = 0.12`
- `LEAD_MAX = 0.4 * M`
- `SKIN = 1e-5`: Sweeps stop this far before a hit.
- `REACH = 6.2 * M`: Boxes farther than this from the pivot cannot touch the arm (5.0 + 0.4 + 0.4 m + the probe).
- `PITCH_MIN = deg_to_rad(-70.0)`
- `PITCH_MAX = deg_to_rad(50.0)`
- `PITCH_REST = deg_to_rad(-10.0)`
- `HL_LATERAL = 0.03`
- `HL_DEPTH = 0.05`
- `HL_VERTICAL = 0.08`
- `HL_VERTICAL_AIR = 0.30`
- `HL_LOOKAHEAD = 0.35`
- `HL_SIDE = 0.12`
- `HL_ZOOM = 0.12`
- `HL_FOV = 0.25`
- `HL_FEELER_IN = 0.05`
- `HL_RELEASE = 0.20`
- `RELEASE_HOLD = 0.15`
- `RECENTER_WAIT = 1.0`
- `RECENTER_HL_WALK = 1.6`
- `RECENTER_HL_RUN = 0.8`
- `RECENTER_MAX = deg_to_rad(135.0)`
- `RECENTER_MIN_SPEED = 0.3 * M`
- `FOV_RUN_ADD = 6.0`
- `AUTO_SWAP_FRAC = 0.5`
- `AUTO_SWAP_TIME = 0.5`
- `ASSIST_YAW = deg_to_rad(10.0)`
- `ASSIST_PITCH = deg_to_rad(6.0)`
- `ASSIST_HL = 0.6`
- `ASSIST_WAIT = 0.5`
- `FEELERS = [[16.0, 0.0, 0.75, 3], [-16.0, 0.0, 0.75, 3], [32.0, 0.0, 0.5, 5], [-32.0, 0.0, 0.5, 5]...`: Predictive feelers (after Lyra): [yaw offset deg, pitch offset deg, weight, retrace interval frames].

### Properties

- `yaw: float`: View angles (radians). FpPlayer writes them on look input and reads them back after update().
- `zoom: float`: Arm length goal before pitch scaling (settings.tps_distance_m, then the wheel).
- `side: float`: Shoulder goal: 1 right, -1 left.
- `assist_target: Vector3`: World point the soft assist leans toward (NAN components: none).
- `agent_boxes: Array[AABB]`: Agent boxes (world AABBs) that pull the arm in hard when the camera would end inside one.
- `cam_xform: Transform3D`: Outputs.
- `update_us: float`: Cost of the last update() in microseconds.
- `sweeps: int`: Sweeps run by the last update().

### Functions

- `func add_look(d_yaw: float, d_pitch: float) -> void`: Look input (radians, already scaled). Clamps pitch to the third-person limits and restarts the recenter and assist delays.
- `func notify_look() -> void`: Marks look input now (the recenter and assist wait from here).
- `func since_look() -> float`: Seconds since the last look input.
- `func step_zoom(dir: int) -> void`: Wheel zoom: dir -1 in, +1 out, in ZOOM_STEP steps within [DIST_MIN, DIST_MAX].
- `func swap_shoulder() -> void`: Q: swap the shoulder goal and clear the auto-swap state.
- `func is_limited() -> bool`: True while the arm is shorter than its free length because of a wall (and until it has eased back out).
- `func snap(feet: Vector3, vel: Vector3, body_yaw: float, eye_h: float, grounded: bool, running: bool, col: CollisionWorld) -> void`: Puts every spring, damper, timer and feeler at its steady state for the current pose (spawn, load, teleport, photo-mode exit): the next frame shows no swoop.
- `func update(dt: float, feet: Vector3, vel: Vector3, body_yaw: float, eye_h: float, grounded: bool, running: bool, col: CollisionWorld) -> void`: One frame. feet, vel (u/s) and body_yaw describe the body; eye_h is the current eye height above the feet (crouch lowers it); col may be null (no collision).
- `func advance(dt: float, flat_speed: float, speed_hint: float, body_yaw: float) -> void`: Advances the look timer and the recentering by dt. FpPlayer calls it inside its movement sub-steps, so the view (and the camera-relative input it steers) turns the same way at any frame rate. flat_speed is the body's horizontal speed, speed_hint the speed the player asks for (both u/s; the larger picks the recenter rate).
- `func current_arm() -> float`: The arm length in use (collision-limited), in units.
- `func free_arm() -> float`: The unobstructed arm for the current zoom and pitch (no run extension).
- `func pivot() -> Vector3`: The damped pivot (neck) the arm hangs from.
